# Ruumly

> Directory and marketplace of local storage, moving and rental providers in the Baltics. Ruumly helps customers compare locations on a map, contact partners, and book online where the partner enables booking. Partners whose registry details, IBAN and physical location Ruumly has confirmed carry a verified-partner badge; most directory profiles are unclaimed listings built from public sources and carry no badge.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ruumly.eu/en): Search and compare storage providers across the Baltics.

- [Search](https://ruumly.eu/en/search): Browse and filter all listings on an interactive map.

- [How it works](https://ruumly.eu/en/how-it-works): Booking flow and platform overview.

- [About](https://ruumly.eu/en/about): Company background and mission.

- [FAQ](https://ruumly.eu/en/faq): Common questions about storage search, optional booking, payments, and partners.

- [Contact](https://ruumly.eu/en/contact): Reach the Ruumly team.

- [Blog](https://ruumly.eu/en/blog): Articles on storage, smart storage, moving, and logistics in the Baltics.

- [Become a partner](https://ruumly.eu/en/provider): List storage locations on Ruumly for free; optional booking and paid visibility tools can be enabled later.

## Featured partners

- [Kookon — Smart self-storage Tallinn](https://ruumly.eu/en/partner/kookon): 9 locations, 246 units, contactless 24/7 access.

- [BOXO — Mini-storage Tallinn](https://ruumly.eu/en/partner/boxo): 6 locations, 102 units, online booking + transport service.

## Content structure

- Listings follow the pattern: /en/warehouse/{id}, /en/moving/{id}, /en/trailer/{id}

- Location hubs follow: /en/location/{id}

- City landing pages: /en/storage/tallinn, /en/storage/riga, /en/storage/vilnius

- Partner profiles: /en/partner/{slug}

## Languages

Available in Estonian (et), English (en), Russian (ru), Latvian (lv), Lithuanian (lt).

All pages available at /{lang}/path.
